description: In-Service Bridge Monitoring Time-Series Dataset (Raw Signals) is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Minyi Di, Danhui Dan. "This dataset contains raw time-series measurements collected on in-service bridges under normal traffic. Data are organized by signal type\u2014strain, support force, and acceleration. Within each signal type, different files correspond to different traffic-flow conditions (e.g., traffic intensity and composition), enabling comparative and generalization studies. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
